reason: I build client sites in Webflow and Framer, and a chat widget wired to an LLM API is a weekend job for me. I'd rather own the code than rent a mascot per month.
objection: I can build this myself with an LLM API and a weekend, and then I don't pay per-conversation limits or carry a 'Powered by' badge on client sites.
would_change_my_mind: A white-label or agency plan with a flat price across many client sites, unlimited conversations, and the mascot and animation set exportable so I can resell it as my own add-on.
